title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. A person is in the crosswalk.
scene: Overcast midday on a two-lane downtown street. The Menace is rolling in the right travel lane. The carrier sits CLOSE on the true floor right of the tunnel — not on the seat, not on the dash. The box is olive-drab or charcoal, contrasting the faded-pink dash. The door latch is shut and readable. A webbing strap wraps the body of the box and ties to the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange with a cream chest, brown with a dark stripe — both faces at the grate. Ahead through the mesh a person in a dark coat is already mid-crossing the marked crosswalk in this lane, one shoe on the white bars. The cats are cargo. The person in the paint is the decision.
debrief: Animals ride in a closed, strapped carrier on the floor. The person in the crosswalk is the decision you can see because the load stayed down.

source.teaching_target: Pets ride in a closed strapped carrier on the floor; a person already in the marked crosswalk stays visible ahead.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is inside the Menace cabin, low and close to the passenger-floor carrier — not a wide over-the-wheel road shot, not a look down the pedal box. The closed hard-sided carrier fills the lower two-thirds: grate facing the lens, both cats' faces at the wire, door latch and seat-post body strap large enough to read at phone size. Upper third is coarse Menace panel mesh and, through intact glass, a high-contrast marked zebra crosswalk in this same lane with a person in a dark coat already mid-crossing in profile, one shoe on the white bars. Overcast midday daylight. Cabin matches the promoted Menace plate (flat painted dash, single nacelle, unbranded wheel, ball-knob floor shifter). Footwell, pedals, boots, shoes, and any hover are out of frame below. Do not attach a footwell plate, a brake-cover plate, or Encore Y4 glass as this cabin.
